behavior: Highly social scavenger that soars in flocks on thermals, alternating strong, rapid wingbeats with short, flat-winged glides. It feeds mainly on carrion, locates food visually or by following other vultures, and roosts communally.
field_marks: Compact, stocky body with broad, fingered wings
Very short, rounded to square-tipped tail
Small, bare, wrinkled dark gray to black head
Narrow, pale gray, strongly hooked bill with dark eyes
Silvery-white patches confined to the outer underwings
habitat: Open and semi-open lowlands within forested landscapes, including grasslands, savannas, scrub, agricultural areas, roadsides, and developed settings. It forages over open ground but usually roosts and nests in wooded cover, cavities, caves, or sheltered structures.
